description: Gemini Spark was announced at Google I/O 2026 on Tuesday. It is a personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent that can take actions on the user’s behalf, rather than waiting for prompts. The agentic AI tool is powered by Gemini 3.5 and is built on the Mountain View-based tech giant’s Antigravity integrated development environment (IDE). Gemini Spark runs on dedicated virtual machines on Google Cloud and is integrated with Google tools.
title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini Spark Brings Agentic Experiences Across Google Docs, Slides and More Apps

description: Google I/O 2026 was hosted on Wednesday, giving everyone a first look at the new features and products the company will be rolling out to users and enterprises. Google CEO Sundar Pichai kicked off the keynote session and announced new artificial intelligence (AI) tools, such as Docs Live.
title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini Omni for AI Videos, Gemini 3.5 Series Models Unveiled

description: Google and Samsung showcased their next-generation smart glasses at the Google I/O 2026 keynote on Tuesday. The product is part of the expanding Android XR ecosystem, designed for extended reality (XR) devices. The companies announced two categories of AI-powered glasses: audio glasses and display glasses, both powered by Gemini AI. The smart glasses are aimed at delivering hands-free assistance without requiring users to look at their smartphones constantly.
title: Google I/O 2026: Google, Samsung Showcase Gemini-Powered Android XR Smart Glasses

description: Google I/O 2026 was hosted on Friday as the Mountain View-based tech giant's latest edition of its annual developer conference. During the keynote, Google’s head Sundar Pichai announced Google now processes more than 3.2 quadrillion tokens per month, which is claimed to be a seven times increase from the same period last year. For reference, the tech giant was processing 480 trillion tokens per month by May 2025, while processing 9.7 trillion tokens per month in the same period in 2024. Moreover, the company has also unveiled its Gemini 3.5 series models, starting with the Gemini 3.5 Flash.
title: Google IO 2026: Here’s Everything That Was Announced From Gemini 3.5 Flash to Gemini Omni

description: Xiaomi has confirmed that the Redmi Turbo 5 will launch in India soon as the first Redmi Turbo series smartphone in the country. A tipster claims the handset could debut in early June with the same specifications as the China model. The phone is tipped to feature a 6.59-inch AMOLED display, MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra chipset, 50-megapixel rear camera, and a 7,560mAh battery with 100W charging. Amazon has already listed a dedicated microsite for the handset.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Launch Timeline Leaked, Tipped to Retain Same Features as Chinese Variant

description: Samsung's next year's Galaxy S27 series is said to feature a new Pro model. It could be a compact model with a 6.4-inch display. It is likely to feature a new camera sensor, a larger battery and a thin build. Meanwhile, the Galaxy S27 Ultra is said to come with a few upgrades over the existing model. It is tipped to feature a significantly larger battery than the existing Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Tipped to Include New Pro Model; Galaxy S27 Ultra Said to Offer Hardware Upgrades

description: Researchers using NASA’s MAVEN observed unusual plasma structures during a major Solar Storm, revealing new details about how solar wind strips away the Martian atmosphere and reshapes the planet over time.
title: Massive Solar Storm Reveals How Mars Is Losing Its Atmosphere

description: Echo Protocol suffered a major exploit after a hacker minted nearly 1,000 unauthorised eBTC worth $76.7 million. The attacker later bridged assets to Ethereum and routed part of the funds through Tornado Cash, while the protocol team said it had regained control of the compromised admin key.
title: Echo Protocol Exploit Sees Hacker Mint Unauthorised eBTC Worth $76.7 Million

description: Xiaomi 17T Pro is all set to launch in global markets on May 28 alongside Xiaomi 17T. Ahead of the official debut, Xiaomi 17T series smartphones have been listed on an e-commerce website, showing their specifications and price details. The Pro model is listed with a 6.83-inch AMOLED screen, while the vanilla Xiaomi 17T is listed with a smaller  6.59-inch AMOLED panel. Both phones run on MediaTek Dimensity chipsets.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro, Xiaomi 17T Price and Specifications Surface on Retail Listing Ahead of May 28 Launch

description: Several Perplexity users woke up last week to find their accounts’ usage significantly reduced. Sharing their frustrations online, these users highlighted that the rate limits were cut short to the point that their daily usage was getting exhausted in just a few queries. The list of impacted users includes those on the free tier and those paying for a subscription.
title: Perplexity Users Claim Their Usage Limit Was Significantly Reduced, Company Reportedly Responds

description: Apple could introduce new AI-powered features aimed at improving personalisation and productivity across the iPhone experience with iOS 27. According to a report, the Cupertino-based tech giant is developing a custom wallpaper generator powered by Image Playground for iPhone, alongside a revamped Shortcuts app with the ability to automate workflows. iOS 27 could also reportedly expand the Apple Intelligence suite with upgraded Writing Tools, AI-assisted grammar checking, and a more advanced chatbot-style version of Siri.
title: iOS 27 Could Bring AI Wallpaper Generator, Smarter Siri, Revamped Shortcuts App to iPhone: Report

description: Created by Tom King, Lanterns is an upcoming superhero-thriller series that is set to land on the screens soon. The series stars Kyle Chandler in the lead role and will include 8 episodes.
title: Lanterns OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch DCU Green Lantern Series Online?

description: Xiaomi 17 Max reportedly appeared on Geekbench ahead of its May 21 launch in China. The listing, shared by a tipster, suggests the phone will use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. Xiaomi has confirmed a 6.9-inch display, a Leica-branded 200-megapixel main camera, and an 8,000mAh battery. The tipster also claims the handset may support 100W wired charging, 50W wireless charging, and feature a 50-megapixel ultra-wide camera and 3x periscope telephoto lens.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Reportedly Spotted on Geekbench Ahead of May 21 Launch

description: Airtel, on Tuesday, introduced a new service for postpaid users aimed at providing uninterrupted and reliable connectivity. Dubbed Priority Postpaid, the new service leverages 5G network slicing to offer access to a fastlane connectivity even in high traffic demand situations. With the launch, the telecom service provider has become the first in India to introduce slicing-based 5G services.
title: Airtel Introduces Priority Postpaid With India's First 5G Network Slicing Starting at Rs. 449

description: Scarlet is a 2025 Japanese fantasy anime inspired by Shakespeare’s Hamlet. The story follows a lonely princess seeking revenge after her father’s death while discovering mysterious powers to travel across time and space. Directed by Momusa Hosoda, the anime is now available to stream on Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV.
title: Scarlet Now Available for Streaming: Where to Watch This Hamlet-Inspired Anime Online?

description: Cookie Monster and Gonger entertain kids with fun food-learning adventures.My Sesame Street Friends: My Cookie Monster Season 1 is now streaming on Netflix India. The delightful Sesame Street spin-off follows Cookie Monster and Gonger as they travel to farms and factories to discover ingredients for popular dishes while teaching children about recipes, cooking and food origins through entertaining adventures.
title: My Sesame Street Friends: My Cookie Monster Season 1 Now Available Online in India: Where to Watch it

description: Vivo S60 will be launched in China on May 29 at 7:30 pm local time (5:00 pm IST), the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. Along with this, the tech firm has revealed the full design of the upcoming smartphone. The Vivo S60 is teased to feature a rectangular rear camera module, housing a dual camera system and an LED flash. The phone appears in a white colourway, with hues of blue at the back. It will feature a flat panel, sporting the Vivo branding, which will be placed at the bottom.
title: Vivo S60 Launch Date Announced; Company Reveals Design and Key Details

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold Wide specifications have leaked ahead of their expected July launch. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 is tipped to feature a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a 200-megapixel main camera, a new 50-megapixel ultra-wide sensor, and a 5,000mAh battery with 45W charging. The Galaxy Z Fold Wide may feature a 7.6-inch inner display, dual 50-megapixel rear cameras, and a 4,800mAh battery with 45W charging support.
title: What to Expect From Samsung's Possible July Event: Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Fold Wide Specifications Leak

description: The Bank of England and the Financial Conduct Authority have proposed extending settlement system operating hours to near-24/7 availability as part of efforts to prepare the UK’s wholesale markets for tokenised finance. The move could support cross-border payments, digital asset settlements, and broader adoption of distributed ledger technologies.
title: Bank of England Pushes for Near 24/7 Settlement System for Tokenised Finance

description: The Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Pro is a capable laptop for your everyday work tasks and more. Of course, if your daily work revolves around presentation slides, pitch decks, Excel work, and multimedia consumption, then the base Galaxy Book 6 is a better option. But if you add more professional tasks, a bit of photo and video editing, and a very little time for casual gaming, then the Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Pro makes much more sense.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Pro Review: The Ultimate On-the-Go Productivity Laptop

description: Motorola Edge 2026 made its first appearance in a new leak, showing off its design. It is said to come in a champagne gold finish with a hole-punch display design. The display has noticeable bezels on all four sides. The design appears similar to the current Edge 2025, but the new model appears to have a flat display and a more premium design compared to the existing model. It has a square-shaped rear camera module placed in the top left corner. The camera island houses three large camera sensors.
title: Motorola Edge 2026 Leaked Renders Show Flat Display and Triple Rear Camera Setup

description: Oppo Reno 16 series’ design has been revealed by the smartphone maker a week before the launch of the lineup. The Oppo Reno 16 series is shown to feature a square-shaped rear camera module, featuring a triple camera system, an LED flash, and the Reno branding. Meanwhile, the centred Oppo branding appears at the bottom of the phone’s flat rear panel. A power button and volume controls will be placed on the right side of the handset, while the left side will feature an unspecified button. Additionally, the Oppo Reno 16 is now listed on the company website for pre-order, revealing its colour options.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Series Design, Colours, and Storage Options Revealed Ahead of May 25 Launch

description: Bhishmar is a Malayalam comedy drama releasing on SunNXT on May 22, 2026. Directed by East Coast Vijayan, the film follows Murukun, a vegetable seller whose life changes after helping a stranger. Featuring Dhyan Srinivasan and Vishnu Unnikrishnan, the movie combines romance, humour, emotional moments and entertaining action sequences.
title: Bhishmar Now Available for Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About This Entertaining Tale

description: Meta is planning to lay off 10 percent of its employees on Wednesday, with additional deep cuts slated to come later this year, Reuters reported previously. In an internal memo, Meta Chief People Officer Janelle Gale also told employees the company plans to move 7,000 employees to new initiatives related to AI workflows and to eliminate managerial roles.
title: Meta Planning to Lay Off 10 Percent of Workforce as Part of AI Driven Restructuring

description: Moto Buds 2 true wireless stereo (TWS) were launched in India on Tuesday, as the tech firm's latest addition to the Moto Buds lineup. The TWS is set to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The Moto Buds 2 will be available for purchase in three colour options, dubbed Pantone Carbon, Pantone Gray Mist, and Pantone Violet Ice. The earbuds are backed by a 62mAh battery each, which is claimed to power the audio device for up to 11 hours on a single charge. With the charging case, the Moto Buds 2 will provide up to 48 hours of battery life.
title: Moto Buds 2 Launched in India With Up to 48 Hours Battery Life, Dual 11mm Dynamic Drivers: Price, Features

description: As per a report by Counterpoint Research, the cumulative sales of the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26 Ultra during the first six weeks following launch were 15 percent higher than those of the Galaxy S25 series during the same period last year. The Galaxy S26 series sales are strong in the US and South Korea. The lineup has weak performance in China and Japan. However, a reversal in sales was observed in the sixth week after launch.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Sales Outpace Galaxy S25 Lineup in First Six Weeks: Counterpoint

description: Google is now rolling out the Gemini usage dashboard to all users. This new space, which is slowly rolling out globally, acts as a space to let users know how soon they will hit their rate limits and plan their usage accordingly. The dashboard provides more transparency to users who frequently reach their usage limit and have to wait for the bar to reset.
title: Google Starts Rolling Out Gemini Usage Dashboard, Adds Weekly Limit

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,000 on Tuesday as investors tracked Federal Reserve signals, rising bond yields, and continued ETF outflows. Analysts said easing geopolitical tensions helped BTC recover from recent lows, though macro uncertainty and weak institutional participation continue to limit upside momentum.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $77,000 as Markets Track Fed Signals and ETF Flows

description: The Amazon Fire TV Stick HD was launched in India on Tuesday as the e-commerce giant’s latest affordable streaming device. It is claimed to deliver over 30 percent faster performance compared to the previous-generation HD model, along with introducing support for HDR10+, Wi-Fi 6, and Xbox cloud gaming. The Amazon Fire TV Stick HD also brings the redesigned Fire TV experience with a cleaner interface and improved navigation. It supports up to 1080p 60fps streaming along with Dolby-encoded audio.
title: Amazon Fire TV Stick HD Launched in India With 1080p Streaming, Xbox Cloud Gaming Support: Price, Specifications

description: Realme Buds Air 8 Pro will launch on May 22. Its Amazon availability has been confirmed through a dedicated page on the e-commerce website. The earphones will be launched with a dual-DAC driver unit. The earphones are promised to last up to 50 hours on a single charge. The Realme Buds Air 8 Pro has an IP55-rated build. It will be launched in Master Black and Master White colour options.
title: Realme Buds Air 8 Pro Amazon Availability Confirmed Ahead of India Launch; Specifications Teased

description: Sony 1000X The ColleXion headphones have appeared in a new leak ahead of their expected May 19 launch. The leak suggests a $649 (roughly Rs. 62,600) price tag and reveals Black and Platinum White colour options, a QN3 and V3 dual-processor setup, 12 microphones for ANC, and up to 24 hours of battery life with noise cancellation enabled. The headphones may feature metal hinges, premium materials, DSEE Ultimate support, and drivers co-tuned with engineers from Battery Studios, Sterling Sound, and Coast Mastering.
title: Sony 1000X 'The ColleXion' Price, Design, and Specifications Leaked Again Ahead of Official Launch

description: Sony will no longer release its first-party single-player games on PC. PlayStation studio boss Hermen Hulst reportedly told staff that the company was ending PC ports of its exclusive games. Recent PS5 exclusives like Ghost of Yotei and Saros, and upcoming first-party single-player titles like Wolverine and Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, will not be ported to PC.
title: PlayStation Studio Boss Says Sony Will End PC Ports of Its First-Party Single-Player Games

description: Apple is scheduled to host its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) 2026 between June 8 and June 12. The four-day event is expected to see various announcements from the Tim Cook-led tech giant, including the introduction of the iOS 27 update. However, the event is also expected to see the announcement of the names of the winners of the Apple Design Awards 2026. Before the event begins, the company has announced the names of the finalists across categories, including Delight and Fun, Inclusivity, Innovation, Interaction, Social Impact, and Visuals and Graphics.
title: Apple Announces Design Awards 2026 Finalists; Guitar Wiz, Hearing Buddy and Pickle Pro Make the Cut

description: Amazon has launched Alexa Podcasts, a new Alexa+ feature that creates AI-generated podcast-style audio episodes on almost any topic. Users can choose a topic, review the outline, and adjust the episode before Alexa generates it. The feature uses information from more than 200 publications, including Reuters and The Washington Post. Alexa Podcasts is now available to Alexa+ users in the US. Amazon says it is also working on personalised news briefings and custom audio based on user documents.
title: Amazon Alexa+ Can Now Create AI-Powered Podcast Episodes on Demand

description: Xiaomi 17T could be launched in India soon, as the smartphone maker has started teasing a new ‘T’ branded device for the country. This comes a day after the company announced that the Xiaomi 17T series will be launched in select global markets next week, on May 28. The lineup is expected to include two models, which could be marketed as the Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro. While the company has yet to reveal the specifications, the Xiaomi 17T Pro and Xiaomi 17T are tipped to feature a telephoto rear camera with up to 5x optical zoom capabilities.
title: Xiaomi 17T India Launch Seemingly Confirmed a Week Ahead of Global Debut

description: Motorola on Tuesday launched the Moto G37 and Moto G37 Power in India. The handsets are part of the company’s latest G-series lineup in the country and are aimed at entry-level smartphone buyers. The Moto G37 and Moto G37 Power are powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 chipset. The former packs a 5,200mAh battery, while the latter ships with a 7,000mAh cell. Both handsets run on Android 16.
title: Moto G37, Moto G37 Power Launched in India With Dimensity 6400 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Sony has announced another price hike for its PlayStation Plus subscription service in select markets. The company cited “ongoing market conditions” as the reason behind the increase. Revised pricing for new subscribers will come into effect beginning May 20, impacting both monthly and three-month plans. Sony has also announced that the price change will not affect existing subscribers unless their subscription lapses or changes, although users in India and Turkey will be exempt from this protection.
title: Sony Hikes PlayStation Plus Price Hike Across Select Markets; Cites ‘Ongoing Market Conditions’

description: Lava has confirmed that the Shark 2 5G will launch in India by the end of May 2026. The smartphone will be priced under Rs. 15,000 and will feature a 6.75-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate, an IP64-rated build, and a large battery. Lava claims the handset can deliver up to 13 hours and 35 minutes of YouTube playback. It will be powered by a chipset that has scored more than 500,000 points on the AnTuTu v11 benchmark.
title: Lava Shark 2 5G Confirmed to Launch in India This Month With 120Hz Display

description: Google is aware of the new bug affecting a number of Android users, which causes the Gmail app to flicker on Android tablets and foldable phones, a report claims. The issue was recently escalated to the Mountain View-based tech giant after various users took to different social media platforms and the Google Forum to complain about the flickering Gmail app bug. Owners of the Samsung Galaxy Tab S9, Galaxy Tab A11, and Galaxy Z Fold lineup have reportedly been the most affected among the lot. However, whether a fix will be rolled out soon or not remains under wraps.
title: Google Is Aware of Gmail App Flickering Issue Affecting Various Android Tablet and Foldable Users, Report Claims

description: Noto 3D emojis are confirmed to be available later this year. As we wait for the formal rollout, a leak has offered a preview of the emojis coming to Android 17. The leak shows refreshed smiley faces, crying faces, animals, food emojis, fruits and drinks, among others. They retain the familiar look of existing emojis, but the new design appears to have a more three-dimensional style. The new emoji set is confirmed to roll out across Google platforms, starting with Pixel phones.
title: Google’s Upcoming Noto 3D Emojis for Android 17 Revealed in New Leak

description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has reaffirmed that GTA 6 will launch on November 19, 2026. In a new interview, the Take-Two boss said the game had been pushed back by around 18 months from its original release date, suggesting Rockstar initially planned to launch GTA 6 in spring 2025.
title: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Reaffirms GTA 6 Release Date, Says Game Was Delayed by 18 Months

description: Google I/O 2026 is all set to begin today (May 19), and the tech giant is expected to make several new announcements about new software features coming to the company's services over the coming months. In recent weeks, the Mountain View-based tech giant has provided us with a glimpse of what’s to come, courtesy of The Android Show. The 2026 edition of the developer conference is expected to outline Google’s roadmap across artificial intelligence (AI), Android, and developer tools.
title: Google I/O 2026 Starts Today: How to Watch Keynote Live and What to Expect
